derivation: Per-node status at the no-op, which is base-revision source under the TARGET test tree, keyed in the same path form sets.json uses. The scorer consults this so a node absent from a run counts as regressed only when the no-op recorded it passing: an absent node that never passed cannot manufacture a regression. Collected counts are the two graded endpoints; the floor is lower because t/unit/backends/test_base.py cannot be imported at the base revision, so none of its nodes are collected there.
